subject: Quota readiness flags and stage cleanup
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quota readiness flags and stage cleanup

Team — quick ask before Friday's forecast sync: I pulled a light snapshot of our April coverage and there are several mid-to-large deals with stale stages or outdated close dates. We need a tidy set for Finance so they can produce the run-rate projection.

Please do the following by EOD Thursday (4/3):
- Update stage to the true state (Proof-of-Concept / Negotiation / Commit) — don't leave deals in "Proposal" if legal is already reviewing.
- Confirm or correct close date; mark as "at-risk" if you don't have a signed PO timeline.
- Set explicit commit level: commit / best-case / upside.

I've attached a quick forecast_snapshot_20270402.csv with the deals I'm most concerned about (sorted by ACV). I'm primarily tagging ACD-4721 (Acadia Health) and a couple of EMEA renewal deals. Ben, can you reconfirm your listed close for Acadia and share the latest MAP?

I'll follow up with the finance deck if anything material changes. Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Quota readiness flags and stage cleanup

Rafael — got it. Quick status on ACD-4721:
- Current stage: Negotiation (legal has the redlines as of 4/1)
- Previously recorded close: 2027-04-15 — realistic close now: 2027-05-10 (legal review + procurement window)
- Commit level: best-case (moving toward commit pending PO)

Attached: ACD-4721-MAP-v1.docx (mutual action plan) and my annotated pricing-sheet-2027Q2.pdf. I'll move the HubSpot close date to 2027-05-10 and mark as "best-case" now.

Ben
Account Executive
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--

Attachment: pricing-sheet-2027Q2.pdf (pricing sheet stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Quota readiness flags and stage cleanup

Thanks for the updates, Ben. A few asks from Finance/Revenue Ops that I'll carry into the forecast meeting:
- For all deals marked "best-case", add a 30% conservative conversion adjustment when we roll to the quarterly coverage number.
- For any deal > $250k ACV with legal engaged, include the expected PO owner and procurement timelines in the HubSpot notes (we had a surprise slip last quarter because procurement was placeholdered).

Laura — can you pull the run-rate projection with the 30% adjustment applied to best-case deals and surface the top 10 deals by adjusted ACV? If possible, have a one-slide summary for Friday's 9am forecast sync.

Rafael/Ben — if Acadia is moving to May, that creates a coverage gap for April that we need to call out to leadership. Please mark any other April-dependent close dates that are at risk.

Marissa
Revenue Operations Manager
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

--
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACD-4721

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acadiahealth.com>

Cc: Acadia Health Legal <legal@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Quota readiness flags and stage cleanup

Hi Ben / Rafael — thanks for the update. Confirming Acadia's expected timeline: legal review needs until end of April, procurement will issue a PO the first week of May. We are not ready to sign before 5/1.

A few notes from our side:
- The MAP looks fine; legal suggested two small redline tweaks (copied to legal).
- Can you provide a final SOW stub and expected start date post-signature? Our procurement needs that to queue internal approval.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call with procurement if that helps accelerate the PO.

Best,
Elena Torres
Director of Digital Platforms
Acadia Health
elena.torres@acadiahealth.com
